plainLanguage: Lubbock is in climate zone 3B on the High Plains. The city publishes its own design-criteria sheet; the only value we could confirm is a ground snow load of 15 psf. Hail is frequent and severe, so impact-resistant (Class 4) shingles are a smart choice and often lower insurance, though we found no code mandate. Footings must be at least 12 inches below grade; the local frost line was not confirmed. Zoning setbacks, permit fees and impact fees still need to be checked with the city before finalizing.
